newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai July disposable per capita income at $80.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai July disposable per capita income at $80.

text.p: Shanghai's disposable per capita income hit 667 yuan ($80.4) in July, ranking it first among China's provinces and provincial-level cities, the China Business Daily said on Friday.
The booming southern province of Guangdong came in second with disposable per capita income of 661 yuan, the newspaper said, quoting the State Statistical Bureau.
The newspaper gave no comparative figures.
It was the first time in years that Shanghai had displaced Guangdong in terms of disposable per capita income.
The former British colony of Hong Kong, which became a special administrative region of China from July 1, was excluded from the count.
